name: for-seven-tubas
description: Bloom — Convergence — Balance, for Tuba Ensemble. Composition system, notation engine and video exporter.
_note: Two dependencies. resvg (day 36): PHASE 2.1 measured it — a 1920x1080 notation frame in 172 ms against headless Chrome's 665 ms per process, at equal fidelity (RUNNING_LOG day 36). socket.io (day 46, PLAN 9g): the stand server's transport, by ruling AR-54 (our own small Socket.IO server, WebSocket only). socket.io-client is for the server's tests only. Everything else — score server, sandbox, notation engine, every tool — is dependency-free Node and stays that way.
